description: Infrastructure and CI: Docker/Compose files, .gitignore additions, GitHub Actions workflow updates for multi-flavor Android and PostgreSQL-backed backend, and deployment documentation. Depends on FEAT-001 (flavor task names) and FEAT-002 (backend structure).
steps: 1. Modify .gitignore: add three lines under the '# Environment variables and secrets' section: backend/.env.local, backend/.env.cloud, backend/.env. These are already covered by the global .env pattern only when at the root; the explicit paths ensure they are ignored even if the global pattern is scoped differently by some git versions.

2. Create backend/Dockerfile. Single-stage build (avoid multi-stage complexity for MVP). Base image: python:3.12-slim (exact tag — add a comment to pin the digest before production). Non-root user: create group 'appgroup' and user 'appuser' with useradd -r. WORKDIR /app. Copy requirements.txt first (layer cache). RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt. Copy app/ directory. Expose port 8000. Switch to appuser with USER appuser. CMD ["uvicorn", "app.main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000"]. No secrets baked in — all config via environment variables at runtime. Add a comment: 'No API keys, passwords, or tokens belong in this file — pass all secrets as environment variables at runtime.'

3. Create docker-compose.yml at the repo root. Services: 'api' and 'db'. db service: image postgres:16-alpine, container_name medihistory-db, environment POSTGRES_DB=medihistory_local POSTGRES_USER=medihistory POSTGRES_PASSWORD uses ${DB_PASSWORD:-changeme_local_only} (never commit a real password), volumes postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data, ports 5432:5432, healthcheck with pg_isready. api service: build context ./backend, container_name medihistory-api, ports 8000:8000, depends_on db (with condition service_healthy), environment block reads from .env.local file (env_file: ./backend/.env.local) with override for DATABASE_URL pointing to the db container: postgresql://medihistory:${DB_PASSWORD:-changeme_local_only}@db:5432/medihistory_local. volumes block at bottom: postgres_data. Add header comment: 'Local development Compose. Requires backend/.env.local. Never use for production.'

4. Create docker-compose.cloud.yml at the repo root. This is a production-oriented override file used with 'docker-compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.cloud.yml'. It overrides the api service: removes the db service (cloud DB is external), sets restart: always, env_file: ./backend/.env.cloud, removes the ports mapping (use a reverse proxy in production), adds a deploy.resources.limits section (memory: 512m). Add header comment: 'Cloud/production Compose overrides. Use with: docker-compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.cloud.yml up. Cloud DB is external — do not run the db service in production.'

5. Modify .github/workflows/android-ci.yml: (a) Replace 'Run lint' step: change lintDebug to lintLocalDebug. (b) Replace 'Run unit tests' step: change testDebugUnitTest to testLocalDebugUnitTest testCloudDebugUnitTest and update env to inject both LOCAL_API_BASE_URL and CLOUD_API_BASE_URL using -P flags (pass as Gradle project properties via the command: ./gradlew testLocalDebugUnitTest testCloudDebugUnitTest -PLOCAL_API_BASE_URL=$LOCAL_API_BASE_URL -PCLOUD_API_BASE_URL=$CLOUD_API_BASE_URL). (c) Update 'Upload lint results' artifact path from lint-results-debug.html to lint-results-localDebug.html. (d) Update 'Upload test results' artifact path from testDebugUnitTest to testLocalDebugUnitTest. (e) Update env block: replace BACKEND_BASE_URL with LOCAL_API_BASE_URL: ${{ vars.LOCAL_API_BASE_URL || 'http://localhost:8000/api/v1/' }} and CLOUD_API_BASE_URL: ${{ vars.CLOUD_API_BASE_URL || 'https://api.medihistory.example.com/api/v1/' }}. (f) Keep all other steps (checkout, JDK setup, Gradle cache, gradlew chmod, security check, upload artifacts) unchanged.

6. Modify .github/workflows/backend-ci.yml: (a) Add a postgres service container under services: postgres: image: postgres:16-alpine, env POSTGRES_DB=medihistory_test POSTGRES_USER=medihistory POSTGRES_PASSWORD=test-password-ci-only, ports 5432:5432, options --health-cmd pg_isready --health-interval 10s --health-timeout 5s --health-retries 5. (b) Update the 'Run pytest with coverage' step's env block: change DATABASE_URL from sqlite:///:memory: to postgresql://medihistory:test-password-ci-only@localhost:5432/medihistory_test, add ENV=local. Keep JWT_SECRET and TESTING as they are. (c) Keep all other steps unchanged. Note: the SQLite URL is kept as a fallback comment only — integration tests now use a real PostgreSQL service container.

7. Modify .github/workflows/pr-checks.yml: (a) In the 'verify-no-secrets-committed' job, add two new steps after the existing checks: 'Check for backend .env files' — find backend/ for .env.local or .env.cloud files and fail if found. 'Check for flavor-specific secrets patterns' — grep Kotlin and XML source for hardcoded URL patterns matching production domains (e.g. grep -rE 'api\.medihistory\.' android/app/src/ and fail if found in non-example files). (b) In the android-ci job within pr-checks.yml, update the run command from 'lintDebug' and 'testDebugUnitTest' to 'lintLocalDebug' and 'testLocalDebugUnitTest testCloudDebugUnitTest' to match the updated android-ci.yml. (c) In the backend-ci job within pr-checks.yml, ensure ENV=local is set.

8. Create docs/deployment/ directory and three documentation files: (a) docs/deployment/build-variants.md — documents the two Android flavors (local/cloud), the four build variants (localDebug, localRelease, cloudDebug, cloudRelease), what each BuildConfig field means, AppConfig accessors and timeout defaults, how to switch variants in Android Studio, and a table of Gradle task names for each variant. (b) docs/deployment/local-setup.md — step-by-step guide for a new developer: install Android SDK, set sdk.dir in local.properties, add local.api.base.url and cloud.api.base.url to local.properties (with example values), install Docker, run docker-compose up, run the app using localDebug variant. (c) docs/deployment/cicd.md — documents the CI pipeline: what each workflow does, what secrets/vars must be set in GitHub (LOCAL_API_BASE_URL, CLOUD_API_BASE_URL, KEYSTORE_PATH, KEYSTORE_PASSWORD, KEY_ALIAS, KEY_PASSWORD), how to add them, and the PR gate requirements.

9. Verify: (a) Run cd android && ./gradlew lintLocalDebug — must pass. (b) Confirm .gitignore now contains backend/.env.local line. (c) Confirm docker-compose.yml exists at repo root and is valid YAML. (d) Confirm the three docs/deployment/*.md files exist.
acceptance_criteria: .gitignore contains explicit entries for backend/.env.local, backend/.env.cloud, backend/.env
backend/Dockerfile builds successfully with 'docker build ./backend' (no secrets baked in, runs as non-root user)
docker-compose.yml at repo root defines api and db services, reads env from backend/.env.local, no hardcoded passwords
docker-compose.cloud.yml defines cloud overrides with restart: always and no db service
android-ci.yml runs lintLocalDebug and testLocalDebugUnitTest testCloudDebugUnitTest with LOCAL_API_BASE_URL and CLOUD_API_BASE_URL injected as Gradle project properties
backend-ci.yml includes a postgres service container and sets ENV=local
pr-checks.yml checks for committed backend/.env.local and backend/.env.cloud files
docs/deployment/build-variants.md, local-setup.md, and cicd.md all exist
verification: python -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('docker-compose.yml'))" (or use 'docker-compose config' if Docker is available)
